part2.audioText: What time should we leave for the airport?
optionAudioTexts: No later than half past five.
part2.explanation: What time 問時間，(B)「最晚五點半」正確。(A) 回答航廈、(C) 回答交通安排。

part2.audioText: Where is this year's sales conference being held?
optionAudioTexts: It lasts two and a half days.
In Valencia, at the convention centre.
part2.explanation: Where 問地點，(C)「瓦倫西亞的會議中心」正確。(B) 回答人數、(A) 回答天數。

part2.audioText: Have the revised drawings been sent to the contractor?
optionAudioTexts: Not yet — I'm waiting on one signature.
part2.explanation: 問是否已送出，(A)「還沒，在等一個簽名」正確。(C) 說明製作者、(B) 說明內容。

part2.audioText: Would it be better to run the survey in September or wait until November?
optionAudioTexts: September — response rates drop over the holidays.
part2.explanation: 選擇疑問句，(B) 選了九月並說明理由。(C) 用 Yes 回答選擇疑問句不合適。

part2.audioText: How many spaces are left in the leadership course?
part2.explanation: How many 問數量，(C)「到今早剩四個」正確。(A) 回答時長、(B) 回答地點。

part2.audioText: Why did we switch to the new courier?
optionAudioTexts: By the end of last quarter.
Around two hundred parcels a week.
part2.explanation: Why 問原因，(A)「他們的週末配送較好」正確。(B) 回答時間、(C) 回答數量。

part2.audioText: Who's going to write up the risk assessment?
optionAudioTexts: I'll take it if nobody else has.
part2.explanation: Who 問人，(B)「如果沒人接我來做」正確。(A) 回答時間、(C) 描述文件。

part2.audioText: The figures in the third column don't add up.
optionAudioTexts: I'll check the formula in that sheet.
part2.explanation: 陳述句指出錯誤，(B)「我去檢查那張表的公式」是解決回應。(C) 與說話者的觀察矛盾。

script: W: Hi Tobias, do you have the visitor numbers for the summer exhibition? The board meets Thursday.
M: I do. Total attendance was just over nineteen thousand, which beats last summer by about eight percent.
W: That's good news. What about the paid workshops?
M: That's where it gets interesting. We ran twenty-four workshops and sixteen filled completely. But the four that didn't fill were all the weekday morning ones.
W: So the demand is there, just not at that time.

M: Exactly. My recommendation for next year is to move those to weekday evenings. The only complication is staffing — our education team currently finishes at five, so we'd need to adjust contracts or bring in freelancers.

questions.explanation: the visitor numbers for the summer exhibition，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What does the man say about the workshops?
options: Weekday morning ones did not fill
questions.explanation: the four that didn't fill were all the weekday morning ones，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What complication does the man mention?
questions.explanation: our education team currently finishes at five, so we'd need to adjust contracts，故選 (B)。

script: M: Good morning. I'm returning a call about my order — the office chairs. The reference is BQ-7-7-1-4.
W: Thank you. Yes, we called because two of the six chairs you ordered are on back order until late October.
M: That's a problem. The new staff start on September 15.

W: I understand. There are two options. We can ship the four available chairs now and the remaining two when they arrive, at no extra delivery cost. Or we can substitute a similar model in the same colour that's in stock.
M: How similar is the substitute?
W: Same frame and adjustment mechanism, slightly firmer cushion. It's actually forty pounds more, but we'd hold the original price given the situation.

questions.q: Why did the company contact the man?
questions.explanation: two of the six chairs you ordered are on back order，是部分延遲，故選 (D)。

questions.q: Why is the delay a problem for the man?
questions.explanation: The new staff start on September 15，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the substitute chair?
options: It comes in a different colour
questions.explanation: It's actually forty pounds more, but we'd hold the original price，故選 (D)。

part4.script: Thanks for tuning in to the Thornbury business report. Our main story this morning concerns the former Kellerman paper mill on the east side of town, which has stood empty since 2019. A development company confirmed yesterday that it has acquired the eleven-acre site and intends to convert the main building into workshop units for small manufacturers. The plan requires no change to the building's exterior, which is protected because of its Victorian brickwork. Council officials say the application should reach the planning committee in January. Reaction has been mixed. The chamber of commerce welcomed the news, pointing to a shortage of light industrial space in the district. Residents of the adjoining streets, however, have raised concerns about lorry traffic on Weir Lane, which is narrow and has no pavement on one side. A public information session is planned for September 12.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the report?
options: The redevelopment of a former mill
questions.explanation: acquired the eleven-acre site and intends to convert the main building into workshop units，故選 (A)。

questions.q: Why will the exterior remain unchanged?
questions.explanation: which is protected because of its Victorian brickwork，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What concern do nearby residents have?
options: Truck traffic on a narrow road
questions.explanation: raised concerns about lorry traffic on Weir Lane, which is narrow，故選 (D)。

part4.script: Hello, this message is for Ms. Delacroix. This is Owen calling from Brightline Insurance about the commercial policy renewal we discussed on Tuesday. I've now had the underwriter's response. The good news is they've agreed to the higher equipment coverage you asked for, and the premium increase is smaller than I estimated — about six percent rather than ten. There is one condition. Because your workshop stores flammable solvents, they require a written confirmation that the storage cabinet meets the current fire standard. A photo of the cabinet's certification label is usually enough. If you can send that by Friday, I can issue the renewal documents before your current policy lapses on September 1. If Friday isn't possible, call me and I'll ask for a short extension. My number is 555-0173.

options: To update a client on a renewal
questions.explanation: about the commercial policy renewal we discussed on Tuesday，並說明核保結果，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the premium?
options: It will rise less than expected
questions.explanation: the premium increase is smaller than I estimated — about six percent rather than ten，故選 (A)。

options: Proof that a storage cabinet meets a standard
A signed contract from a supplier
questions.explanation: they require a written confirmation that the storage cabinet meets the current fire standard，故選 (B)。

part5.q: The consultant's fee does not include travel expenses, ------- are billed separately.
part5.explanation: 非限定關係子句以逗號隔開，先行詞為物，用 which。

part5.q: The building's heating system is inspected ------- a year by a certified engineer.
part5.explanation: twice a year「一年兩次」為固定用法。

part5.q: Staff must obtain ------- approval before purchasing equipment over £500.
part5.explanation: 修飾名詞 approval 用過去分詞形容詞 written（書面的）。

part5.q: The launch was delayed ------- a problem with the supplier's certification.
part5.explanation: 空格後為名詞片語，需用介系詞片語 owing to（由於）。

part5.q: Ms. Trang has been with the company ------- longer than anyone else on the board.
part5.explanation: much 可修飾比較級 longer；very 不能修飾比較級。

part5.q: The report concludes that remote work has had a ------- effect on retention.
part5.explanation: 修飾名詞 effect 需用形容詞 measurable（可量測的、明顯的）。

part5.q: Please notify reception ------- you expect a delivery after five o'clock.
part5.explanation: if 引導條件子句，「如果你預期五點後有貨到」。

part5.q: The company's recycling rate rose from forty ------- sixty-two percent in two years.
part5.explanation: from A to B「從 A 到 B」為固定搭配。

part5.q: All candidates will be assessed ------- the same set of criteria.
part5.explanation: assess against criteria「依據標準評量」為常見搭配。

part5.q: Not only ------- the deadline, but the team also reduced costs by twelve percent.
part5.explanation: Not only 置句首需倒裝，用助動詞 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

part5.q: The instructions specify that the adhesive must dry ------- before the panels are joined.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 dry 需用副詞 completely。

part5.q: The workshop was cancelled because of ------- interest from members.
part5.explanation: 取消的原因應為「興趣不足」，用形容詞 insufficient 修飾 interest。

part6.passage:
To: All Users of the Rowan Building
From: IT Services
Subject: Wireless Network Upgrade

On Saturday, September 5, we will replace the wireless access points throughout the Rowan Building. The work will begin at seven in the morning and should be [33] by early afternoon.

During the work, wireless service will be unavailable. Wired connections at desks will continue to function [34], so anyone who must work on site that day should bring an Ethernet cable.

After the upgrade, you will need to reconnect your devices. The network name stays the same, but the security settings change, so saved passwords will not work. Instructions [35] on the intranet by Friday afternoon.

We expect noticeably better coverage in the basement archive and the third-floor meeting rooms, where signal complaints have been most frequent.

questions.explanation: be 動詞 be 後接過去分詞形成被動 be completed（被完成）。
修飾動詞 function 需用副詞 normally（正常地）。
Instructions 為被動且指未來（by Friday afternoon），用 will be posted。

part6.passage:
Ellery & Sons Garden Centre — Autumn Newsletter

Autumn is the best season for planting most trees and shrubs, [36] the soil is still warm and rainfall is more reliable. Roots establish themselves before winter, which gives plants a real advantage the following spring.

This month we are offering twenty percent off all bare-root fruit trees. Bare-root stock is cheaper than potted stock and often establishes more quickly, but it must be planted [37] after purchase — ideally the same day.

Our staff are happy to advise on variety selection. Bring a photograph of your site and, if possible, a note of how many hours of direct sun the area receives. That single piece of information [38] more planting failures than anything else we see.

Open daily, eight to six.

questions.explanation: 後句說明原因（土壤仍溫暖、降雨穩定），用 since（因為）。
修飾動詞 be planted 需用副詞 promptly（立即地）。
主詞 That single piece of information 為單數，需用單數動詞 prevents。

HOLLOWAY MANUFACTURING — SUPERVISOR TRAINING, SEPTEMBER

All shift supervisors must complete four modules by December 31. Modules may be taken in any order except that Module 3 requires Module 1.

Module 1 — Safety Leadership. September 3 and September 17, 9:00–12:00. Held in Training Room A. Capacity 16.

Module 2 — Managing Difficult Conversations. September 9, 13:00–17:00. Held off site at the Grantley Centre. Capacity 12. Transport is not provided.

Module 3 — Incident Investigation. September 24, 9:00–16:00. Training Room A. Capacity 10. Participants must bring a completed pre-work sheet.

Module 4 — Scheduling and Absence. Online, self-paced. Available from September 1. Approximately three hours.

Bookings close five working days before each session. Supervisors who cannot attend a September date will find repeat sessions in October and November, except for Module 3, which runs only in September and November.
